notes.title: Montaro 2 DEMO is now available.
notes.notes:
Montaro 2 is a stealth game where you are a clever doggo, navigating through various locations such as shopping streets, residential areas, schools, stations, and public swimming pools to complete sneaky missions and steal interesting items. 
Sneak into different scenes, use the environment and props to hide from store clerks, and accomplish mission objectives.
[h2]Featuring:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Cute Shiba Inu
[*]Busy humans
[*]Underwear
[*]Woof!
[/list]

notes.title: Version update for windows7 64bits
notes.notes:
There were some compatibility issues with windows 7 64 bits.
You can run the game with Steam now.
Please re-download the game.

Right click "Montaro" in "Library"
Choose "Properties"
Go to "Local Files"
Choose "Verify integrity of game cache..."
"Montaro" will update or re-download
Thanks for your support and patient!

-------------------------------------

之前梦太郎在WINDOWS 7 64位元有一些相容性的问题，
现在你可以直接从STEAM上启动了，
请重新下载或者检查档案的完整性

在"库"右键点选Montaro
选择 "属性"
点选 "本地文件"
选择 "确认游戏快取档的完整性..."
这样就能在windows7 64bit 上运行了！
感谢你耐心地等待!

-------------------------------------

之前夢太郎在WINDOWS 7 64位元有一些相容性的問題，
現在你可以直接從STEAM上啟動了，
請重新下載或者檢查檔案的完整性

在"收藏庫"右鍵點選Montaro
選擇 "內容"
點選 "本機檔案"
選擇 "確認遊戲快取檔的完整性..."
這樣 就能支援 Windows7 64bit 了!

感謝你耐心地等待!

notes.title: Windows 7 64 bits compatibility issues (already fixed)
notes.notes:
There are some compatibility issues with windows 7 64 bits.
I'm currently working on it, it will be fixed asap.

Current solution:
Goto game directory and modify the compatibility of file "nw.exe" into Windows 7 and run it without steam:

Step by Step Instruction:
1.Goto "Libary" in steam 
2.Right click "Montaro"
3.Choose "Properties"
4.Goto "Local Files" tab
5.Choose "Browse local files..."
6.Right click file "nw.exe"
7.Choose "Properties"
8.Goto "Compatibility" tab
9.Check "Run this program in compatbility mode for:"
10.Choose "Windows 7"
11.Click "Apply"
12.Click "OK"
13.Run the file "nw.exe" 
14. Ejoy the game, this bug will be fixed asap.(currently the game in windows7-64bit cannot run with steam)

------------------

现在游戏在Windows7-64位元有些相容性的问题，目前正在处理中，会尽快修正

目前的解决办法:
前往游戏目录，将档案"nw.exe"相容性改为Windows7，直接执行"nw.exe":

详细步骤:
1.对"收藏库"中的 "Montaro" 点击右键
2.选取"内容"
3.然后最上方选取 "本机档案"
4.点击"开启本机档案"
5.对档案"nw.exe"点击右键
6.选取"内容"
7.最上方选取"相容性"
8.将"以相容模式执行这个程式"打勾
9.选择"Windows7"
10."套用"后"确定"
11.直接执行"nw.exe"就可以正常执行游戏了，暂时无法透过steam开启
12.享受你的梦太郎，这个BUG会尽快修正

---------------

現在遊戲在Windows7-64位元有些相容性的問題，目前正在處理中，會盡快修正

目前的解決辦法:
前往遊戲目錄，將檔案"nw.exe"相容性改為Windows7，直接執行"nw.exe":

詳細步驟:
1.對"收藏庫"中的 "Montaro" 點擊右鍵 
2.選取"內容" 
3.然後最上方選取 "本機檔案" 
4.點擊"開啟本機檔案"
5.對檔案"nw.exe"點擊右鍵
6.選取"內容"
7.最上方選取"相容性"
8.將"以相容模式執行這個程式"打勾
9.選擇"Windows7"
10."套用"後"確定"
11.直接執行"nw.exe"就可以正常執行遊戲了，暫時無法透過steam開啟
12.享受你的夢太郎，這個BUG會盡快修正
